contribution_requirements: USER: do NOT write new test classes; only fix existing tests if changes break their compilation; impl notes (.agents/tasks/teacher_impl.md) must begin with 'Tests intentionally skipped per user request'. Business rule: NOT a teacher marketplace - only the active teacher, no teacher lists/search/discovery, no hardcoded teacher ids outside mock data files. Every new string key in BOTH values/strings.xml and values-ar/strings.xml. No hardcoded strings or colors in composables, no business logic in composables. Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (repo history: 'feat: locked courses with subscribe & pay checkout', 'fix: ...').
key_patterns: MVI: BaseMviViewModel<S : MviState, I : MviIntent, E : MviEffect> (core/common .../mvi/BaseMviViewModel.kt) with setState{copy()}, sendEffect, currentState(); Contract file per screen (UiState data class, sealed Intent, sealed Effect). Stateful Screen(viewModel = koinViewModel(), navigator: AppNavigator = koinInject()) collects effects in LaunchedEffect(viewModel.effect) and resolves strings with stringResource, then calls stateless XxxContent(state, snackbarHostState, onIntent). Screens nested in Home's Scaffold use Scaffold(contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0,0,0,0)). Use cases: class XUseCase(private val repository: R) { suspend operator fun invoke(...) = repository.x(...) }. Mock repositories: delay(...) then Result.success, with '// TODO: replace with real API call — <METHOD> <path>'. Koin: singleOf(::Impl) bind Interface::class, factoryOf(::UseCase), viewModel { VM(get(), ...) }, parametersOf for args. Payment rule: createCheckout then verify; unlock ONLY after backend verification; keep pendingSessionId and re-verify on PENDING (see CourseDetailViewModel). Price: Money.formatted() (internal @Composable in tabs/courses/presentation/common/PriceFormatting.kt). String placeholders filled via stringResource(res, arg) or .replace("%1\$s", ...). Time in common code: kotlin.time.Clock with @OptIn(ExperimentalTime::class) + kotlinx.datetime Instant/TimeZone/toLocalDateTime (see tabs/home/HomeTabViewModel.kt). Designsystem tokens in Color.kt (ScholarlyTeal, SurfaceContainerLowest, SurfaceContainerLow, OutlineVariant, OnBackground, OnPrimary, SuccessGreen, LiveRed, AmberLight/AmberDark). Course card look: 16.dp RoundedCornerShape, SurfaceContainerLowest, BorderStroke(1.dp, colorScheme.outlineVariant), 0 elevation.
